name: radix-public-sdl
cmd: set -uo pipefail; OUT=$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR; bun install --frozen-lockfile > "$OUT/install.log" 2>&1 || exit $?; bun core/cli.ts lift radix-retained research/bapa/lift-fixtures/simple_decentralized_lock.json --out "$OUT/project" --sha256 e123183e89e3d5e0378d9aaf3e4d00a5f7e55b3584821faf0c6fa2d739e82958 --timeout-ms 600000 --json > "$OUT/public.log" 2>&1; status=$?; if [ -d "$OUT/project/.lake" ]; then rm -rf "$OUT/project/.lake"; fi; exit $status
